questions.question: Why were the men of Ephraim angry with Jephthah, the leader of Gilead, after his war?

answers.text: He fought the Ammonites without calling them
He kept the Ammonite land for Gilead
He made a treaty with the Ammonites

questions.question: Jephthah told the angry men of Ephraim who delivered the Ammonites into his hand. Who was it?
When the men of Gilead tested Ephraimites at the Jordan, why did saying "Sibboleth" give a man away?

answers.text: He could not pronounce it correctly
He did not know what it meant
He answered too slowly at the ford
